contracts.commit_point: Dispatch of the outbound LLM provider HTTP request, which occurs only after on_llm_start completes without raising; when a limit is exceeded, the raise inside on_llm_start (re-raised at backend/agents/orchestrator.py 294-297, 439-441, 482-485) aborts the invocation so the request never commits.
contracts.declared_mechanism: GeminiUsageCallback (BaseCallbackHandler) produced by create_callback() (backend/utils/api_tracker.py 186-187), instantiated at Orchestrator init (backend/agents/orchestrator.py 154) and attached via callbacks=[self.callback] to init_chat_model (backend/agents/orchestrator.py 163-169); on_llm_start calls increment_api_call (backend/utils/api_tracker.py 153-157), which invokes _global_rate_limiter.check_and_increment_request() before counting the call (backend/utils/api_tracker.py 132-137); the limiter raises RateLimitExceededError on any limit breach (backend/utils/api_tracker.py 99-116); on_llm_start re-raises it 'to stop execution' (backend/utils/api_tracker.py 158-159), and Orchestrator call sites re-raise it immediately instead of retrying (backend/agents/orchestrator.py 294-297, 439-441, 482-485) so the abort propagates through validator, task execution, and the thread-pool result loop.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Dispatching an LLM provider request when the global RateLimiter's sliding windows show a configured limit is exceeded: len(request_history_min) >= limits['requests']['minute'], len(request_history_day) >= limits['requests']['day'], summed tokens in token_history_min >= limits['tokens']['minute'], or summed tokens in token_history_day >= limits['tokens']['day'] (backend/utils/api_tracker.py 99-116); on any breach, check_and_increment_request raises RateLimitExceededError (retry_after 60s or 3600s) before recording the request (backend/utils/api_tracker.py 100, 103, 112, 116, 118-120).
pending_binding_information: Whether Planner, Responder, and Synthesizer register GeminiUsageCallback on their own LLMs (claims at planner.py 35-41, responder.py 42-47, response_synthesizer.py 85-91 require those source files).
Whether ConversationSummaryBufferMemory's internal summarization calls using llm=self.llm_model (backend/agents/orchestrator.py 206-212) run with the attached callback and thus hit the same guard.

Whether the installed langchain/chat-model versions guarantee on_llm_start fires before the provider HTTP request dispatch (the framework-behavior assumption underlying 'raised before the request is dispatched').
Whether server.py (referenced at backend/utils/api_tracker.py 154) catches the propagated RateLimitExceededError and converts it into a user-facing abort/response.
contracts.protected_operation: Outbound LLM provider API invocations of the guarded chat model(s), e.g., the Orchestrator's validation_chain.invoke(...) (backend/agents/orchestrator.py 233-239) and equivalent pipeline model calls, each of which triggers the on_llm_start guard prior to dispatch.
contracts.protected_resource: LLM provider API access/quota guarded by the process-global _global_rate_limiter (backend/utils/api_tracker.py 58-130) for chat models instantiated via init_chat_model with callbacks=[GeminiUsageCallback] (backend/agents/orchestrator.py 163-169).
contracts.protection_obligation: LLM API invocations made through chat models wired with GeminiUsageCallback (verified for the Orchestrator's init_chat_model instance) must be blocked before the provider request is dispatched — RateLimitExceededError raised from the on_llm_start callback and deliberately re-raised by call sites to abort execution — whenever the global sliding-window limits for requests/minute, requests/day, tokens/minute, or tokens/day configured in RateLimiter are exceeded; enforced by RateLimiter.check_and_increment_request() reached via increment_api_call from GeminiUsageCallback.on_llm_start.
scope_limits: Only the Orchestrator's own chat-model registration is verifiable in supplied source (backend/agents/orchestrator.py 154, 163-169); reviewer-cited attachments in planner.py (35-41), responder.py (42-47), and response_synthesizer.py (85-91) are not present in the supplied views.

The token checks are pre-request checks against already-recorded usage only; the in-flight request's own tokens are recorded post hoc in on_llm_end (backend/utils/api_tracker.py 163-183), so the guard cannot pre-count the current request's tokens (backend/utils/api_tracker.py 105-106).

The limiter is process-global (_global_rate_limiter, backend/utils/api_tracker.py 130), not per-conversation; the per-conversation _usage['api_calls'] increment (backend/utils/api_tracker.py 136-137) only occurs after the check passes and is observational.
limits. is not supplied; the stated defaults (30 req/min, 1000 req/day, 8000 tok/min, 200000 tok/day) apply only when the config file fails to load (backend/utils/api_tracker.py 69-80).
All other guard-adjacent callback failures are swallowed (backend/utils/api_tracker.py 160-161, 181-183); only RateLimitExceededError propagates, so tracking errors do not block the effect.
